order: agent-multi@036ed36e — WP3 effect executor, implementation and effect-free tests only

PRE.absence: permits_dependent_effects() had NO executing consumer — grep over app/ and tools/ found only its definition and its tests. The gate existed and nothing drove it, which is exactly why C10 acceptance withheld live parity.

POST.module: app/effect_executor.py — one shared orchestration layer consumed by both venue adapters; it reimplements no weekly-flat policy.
enforced_sequence: 1. the plan (directive digest, policy digest, authority identity, effect list) is persisted durably BEFORE any effect

2. cancel_pending_entries runs first, restricted to the directive's named identities, each re-verified as an ENTRY in fresh direct order evidence immediately before the cancel — a protective identity is refused twice and can never reach the port
3. terminal venue outcomes feed permits_dependent_effects(); rejection, fill-before-cancel, still-open, unknown disappearance, stale evidence and a missing verdict each STOP the plan
4. the directive, policy and authority identities are re-checked immediately before the dependent effect, with the authority re-hashed from disk

5. a forced flatten opens the accepted live custody BEFORE the close; the obligation id derives from the plan id so a resumed plan can never mint a sibling; confirmation requires fresh direct zero/zero evidence or the plan stays unresolved
6. every transition and acknowledgement is journaled idempotently in a digest-chained O_EXCL/fsync journal; replay verifies the whole chain and refuses a broken one

asymmetric_effect_semantics.submit_decision: adds risk — strictly at-most-once. A requested decision with no journaled acknowledgement is an ambiguous window: resume fails closed as unresolved and NEVER re-issues, because 'we do not know whether the venue received it' must not become a doubled order.
asymmetric_effect_semantics.request_close: reduce-only and judged solely by direct zero/zero evidence — an unacknowledged request may be re-issued safely.
asymmetric_effect_semantics.cancel_order: reduce-only on the order book — an acknowledged cancellation is never re-issued; an unacknowledged one may be.

POST.election: the plan claim is an exclusive create, and the scratch name carries pid AND thread id so concurrent invocations contend at the FINAL exclusive create — the actual election point. Duplicate invocation refuses with PlanAlreadyClaimed; a barrier-synchronised concurrent pair elects exactly one effect (total submits == 1).

acceptance_tests.long_and_short: parent entry plus both protective children on long and short Alpaca books — only the parent identity is ever cancelled
acceptance_tests.gate_failures: rejected, filled_before_cancel, still_open, gone_without_verdict, missing verdict and partial cancellation (unresolved identity NAMED) each stop the plan with zero dependent effects; a stale snapshot stops before any cancellation is issued

crash_boundaries.before_cancellation: resume completes; cancel issued exactly once
crash_boundaries.between_cancellation_and_verdict: resume never re-issues the acknowledged cancel; completes
crash_boundaries.after_verdict_before_dependent_effect: resume runs the decision exactly once
crash_boundaries.ambiguous_submit_window: requested, never acknowledged — resume returns unresolved and the port shows ZERO submits
crash_boundaries.after_close_before_confirmation: resume does not re-request the acknowledged close, confirms on flat evidence, and the custody store holds exactly ONE obligation — no sibling

acceptance_tests.tampered_journal: one altered record breaks the digest chain and resume refuses
acceptance_tests.both_venues: Alpaca and MT5 directives from equivalent exposure carry the SAME overlay, final command and effects while each cancels its own representation (parent-order-id vs ticket 200001), and the executor drives both
acceptance_tests.no_write: the executor imports no network client (structural scan); a protection-only plan completes with zero port calls on the refusing interface; a write plan stops loudly at WriteAttempted; the refusing dry-run interface is the only shipped port and now satisfies the executor protocol
acceptance_tests.mutation_check: disabling the gate, re-issuing the ambiguous submit and skipping the live-book protective check broke 8 tests together; green on revert

boundaries: Implementation and tests only. No service install/restart, no live activation, no venue connection, no order command; existing Alpaca and MT5 positions untouched. WP4 stays blocked until this executor is independently reproduced.
